description: #791 consumers of changed keys: a contract entry gains `repo-configurable: true` (the #784 class) and a shell resolver starts accepting a new PLATFORM value (the #793 class). The anchors are the real change_anchors output for source_diff over repo_files (pinned by tests/test_change_anchors.py): the YAML line resolves to its list item's id, the shell comparison to a `branch` key, and TANGLED_REPO_DID to an env key. Both scanners grep the variants in unchanged files (code before docs and tests) and then in changed files outside the added lines, so the env read in run_evidence_providers.py, the action.yml wiring, and the fall-through dispatch sites appear.

repo_files.action.yml:
name: reviewer
description: Reviews pull requests.
inputs:
  evidence_providers_file:
    description: Provider definitions file.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: evidence
      shell: bash
      env:
        EVIDENCE_PROVIDERS_FILE: ${{ inputs.evidence_providers_file }}
      run: python3 scripts/run_evidence_providers.py
repo_files.contracts/action-v3.yml:
inputs:
  - id: model-name
    type: string
    description: Model to call.
  - id: evidence-providers-file
    type: path
    repo-configurable: true
    description: Provider definitions file.
  - id: sarif-files
    type: path
    description: SARIF inputs.
repo_files.scripts/check_review_needed.sh:
RESOLVED_PLATFORM="$(platform_resolve)"
if [[ "$RESOLVED_PLATFORM" == "forgejo" ]]; then
  echo forgejo
fi

source_diff:
diff --git a/action.yml b/action.yml
index 90b967e..c2016f5 100644
--- a/action.yml
+++ b/action.yml
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 name: reviewer
+description: Reviews pull requests.
 inputs:
   evidence_providers_file:
     description: Provider definitions file.
diff --git a/contracts/action-v3.yml b/contracts/action-v3.yml
index c9b5286..813adf6 100644
--- a/contracts/action-v3.yml
+++ b/contracts/action-v3.yml
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@ inputs:
     description: Model to call.
   - id: evidence-providers-file
     type: path
+    repo-configurable: true
     description: Provider definitions file.
   - id: sarif-files
     type: path
diff --git a/scripts/platform_api.sh b/scripts/platform_api.sh
index 0ba9ea6..f61de18 100644
--- a/scripts/platform_api.sh
+++ b/scripts/platform_api.sh
@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@
 platform_resolve() {
   local p="${PLATFORM:-github}"
+  if [[ "$PLATFORM" == "tangled" && -z "${TANGLED_REPO_DID:-}" ]]; then
+    return 1
+  fi
   printf '%s' "$p"
 }
